name: Sid Wilson
description: '''Sidney George Wilson''' (born January 20, 1977) is an American [[Disc jockey|DJ]] and [[keyboardist]] and [[turntablist]]. He is best known for being the former DJ and keyboardist for the [[Nu metal|heavy metal]] band [[Slipknot (band)|Slipknot]], in which he was designated '''#0''', until his firing from the band on August 14, 2026.
